subject: per-phy-u-find
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.------TRS.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-27 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the over-balance of information from the western perceived affinity alignment (taught without regard for its progressional significance — source initiation) must be viewed as a negative factor for positive transformation.' (C)PER-PHY-U-FIND (so drawn at the arrow; the title reads PER.PHY.U.FUND., perceived physical universe fundamental) is crossed with TRS (transition): the question is what the subject produces when crossed with transition — perceived being the load-bearing qualifier. LANG-DY (language dynamics) branches from the main line. INFO-CO also branches from the main line and carries two chains: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) to GRAD (gradualism) to IST-F-ACT (isolated focus activism), and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality), which carries WO-MTH (world methodology) and A-PR (all-purpose).
